signals.text: I ordered these slacks for my husband mostly because of the light weight and the tapered fit.  He tends to wear his slacks very loose, I think out of habit more than anything else.  These slacks fit very well and look great.  The light weight is perfect for summer as well as spring and early fall.  They wash well and do not wrinkle much at all, though I do iron them after every wash.  Highly recommended.
Great fit a look. The material has the perfect amount of flexibility. They have a very nice polished look. I use primary as work pants. Overall I’m very pleased with these.
